summary: A shop with an exemption has to check the mark on the delivery before putting drinks on its shelves.
realLife: Hindman moved to keep city-marked stock out of exempt retail sales and distributor deliveries. The council enacted the amended exemption.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: store exemption and distributor markings.

turns.what: The receiving clerk puts the delivery out for sale.
turns.pulledBy: A delivery is correctly marked for the exempt outlet.
turns.writesBack: The shop can stock it under the exception.

turns.what: The receiving clerk holds the cases on the loading dock.
turns.pulledBy: The shipment carries the city's return mark.
turns.writesBack: The retailer asks the distributor for replacement stock.
